widgets.text: Puzzle mode: place the given arrows on the floor before pressing Start, so every ChuChu (mouse) reaches your rocket and none touches a KapuKapu (cat) or falls in a hole. Mice and cats turn right when they hit a wall; arrows override that.

Battle mode (vs CPU or link): place arrows live to lead mice into your rocket and cats into the others'. Special mice (gold = 50) and the ? mouse trigger roulette events (Mouse Mania, Cat Attack, Speed Up, Place-Arrows-Again...). A cat in your rocket costs a third of your mice.
widgets.title: Tips

rows: 25 puzzles each in Easy, Normal, Hard, Special, Mania (unlock in order)
Timed task rounds (catch X mice in Y seconds)

widgets.text: Each puzzle gives a fixed set of arrows (shown at the side). Two arrows on the same tile are not allowed; a cat that walks over an arrow twice in battle mode wears it down.
Clearing every puzzle level unlocks the next difficulty; finishing Mania unlocks the hidden set.
